cards.power: Mirror Lock. Skip 3 turns. If water ripples, take 5 Emotional Damage.
cards.lore: I'd help you, but I'm currently busy existing as a visual masterpiece.

cards.power: Intimidating Decor. Use antlers in decorating to gain +2 Presence.
cards.lore: No one spits like me. I am nature's special effect.

cards.power: Dorian's Pact. Transfer physical damage to the card in hand.
cards.lore: The painting ages so I don't have to. Don't look in the attic.

cards.power: Crop & Filter. Remove 'Negative Vibes' tokens. Ignore reality.
cards.lore: If I didn't post it, did the forest really burn down? Doubtful.

cards.power: Rewrite History. Force opponent to discard last card and apologize.
cards.lore: I never said that. And if I did, you made me say it.

cards.power: Tone Policing. Negate argument by repeating it in a whiny voice.
cards.lore: You're crazy. You're imagining things. You're just like your mother.

cards.power: Love Bomb. Offer a gift. If accepted, swallow opponent whole next turn.
cards.lore: Mother knows best. Stay in the dark. It's dangerous out there.

cards.power: Alternative Facts. Change game rules mid-turn.
cards.lore: We have always been at war with Eastasia. I have always been the victim.

cards.power: Ratings Crash. If Adoration drops below 5, Laser Eye the board.
cards.lore: You guys are the real heroes. I'm just a god.

cards.power: Memory Charn. Steal an Ability. Claim invention.
cards.lore: Fame is fickle, Harry. But stolen shiny objects are forever.

cards.power: Performative Empathy. Cry one tear on camera. Gain +10 Support.
cards.lore: I just want to be loved. Is that a crime? (Yes, it is murder).

cards.power: Stolen Valor. Sacrifice minions to gain a medal.
cards.lore: I have won battles I wasn't even present for. That is leadership.

cards.power: The Family Name. Discard a 'Child' card to save reputation.
cards.lore: A lion does not concern himself with the opinions of the sheep he sired.

cards.power: Infantilize. Opponent cannot move without permission.
cards.lore: You'll never leave me. You're too weak. I made sure of it.

cards.power: No Wire Hangers. Deal 10 Psychic Damage. Scream until glass breaks.
cards.lore: I gave you life! And this is how you repay me? With dirt?

cards.power: Triangulation. Transfer all blame to Scapegoat.
cards.lore: Why can't you be more like your brother? He sparkles.

cards.power: Silian Rail. Stun opponent with superior card stock.
cards.lore: Look at that subtle off-white coloring. It's... beautiful.

cards.power: Disrupt. Destroy game board. Claim you saved humanity.
cards.lore: Move fast and break things. Mostly people. People are things.

cards.power: CC on Reply All. Freeze productivity for 3 turns.
cards.lore: I need you to maximize synergy by asking me before you breathe.

cards.power: Influencer. Convert Followers into Currency. Hollow out soul.
cards.lore: It's not a pyramid scheme. It's a trapezoid of opportunity!

cards.power: Smash. Destroy all cards on table. Including yours.
cards.lore: I ordered the tea ICED! ICED! THE JUNGLE IS RUINED!

cards.power: Explosive Sensitivity. If criticized, deal 20 damage to everyone.
cards.lore: Are you saying I'm puffy? You're dead. You're all dead.

cards.power: Petty Vengeance. Spend all energy to inflict 1 point of annoyance.
cards.lore: I don't want the honey. I just want the flower to suffer.

cards.power: Sonic Wall. Silence all logic.
cards.lore: AAAAAAHHHHHHHHH!!! (Pay attention to me!)

cards.power: The Snap. Remove 50% of the deck. Perfectly balanced.
cards.lore: I'm the only one with the will to act. Also, I want a banana.

cards.power: Delete. Write a name. Eliminated after 40 seconds.
cards.lore: I will become the God of the new sewer.

cards.power: Divine Right. All players must bow (skip turn) or be blinded.
cards.lore: Without me, the day does not start. Worship the sphere!

cards.power: Mechanize. Turn organic cards into rigid metal.
cards.lore: Nature is messy. I have fixed it. You're welcome.

cards.power: Proxy War. Attack opponent. Narcissist takes no blame.
cards.lore: The Boss is actually really nice once you get to know him!

cards.power: Absorb Abuse. Take double damage so Narcissist takes none.
cards.lore: If I just stay quiet, maybe he won't yell today.

cards.power: Echo Chamber. Double effectiveness of Gaslighting.
cards.lore: Brilliant, sir! Genius, sir! You're so right, sir!

cards.power: Vibe Kill. Drain 2 Action Points from every player.
cards.lore: I don't drink blood. I drink your will to live.

cards.power: Validation Loop. Recover full health by lying to yourself.
cards.lore: You are the fairest. Everyone else is trash.

cards.power: High Ground. +5 Attack, but instant death if you fall.
cards.lore: It's lonely at the top. But the view of you ants is great.

cards.power: Doomscroll. Paralyze opponent with envy.
cards.lore: Feed me attention. I am starving in 4K resolution.

cards.power: Victim Card. Immunity to criticism by claiming persecution.
cards.lore: Look how much I suffer for you! LOOK AT IT!

cards.power: Guilt Trip. Opponent loses turn due to obligation.
cards.lore: No, go have fun. I'll just stay here and rot. Alone.

cards.power: Medical Mystery. Feign illness to escape accountability.
cards.lore: I would apologize, but my condition is flaring up.

cards.power: The Last Straw. Explode over minor inconvenience. Recall grievance from 1994.
cards.lore: I forgive. But I never, ever, ever forget.

cards.power: Main Character Syndrome. The music swells. You matter most.
cards.lore: My darkness is too deep for you to understand.

cards.power: Delusion. Defense is 0, but you act like it is 10.
cards.lore: Is it a draft? Or just the chill of pure excellence?

cards.power: Despair. Look on my works, ye Mighty, and lose turn.
cards.lore: King of Kings. Name implies heavy depreciation.

cards.power: Insatiable. Discard your hand. It is not enough.
cards.lore: More. More. It's never enough. Fill the hole.

cards.power: Nostalgia Trap. Become immune to the present.
cards.lore: I used to be somebody. I used to be big.

cards.power: Cut & Paste. Physically cut an opponent's card in half.
cards.lore: Rules are for people who don't have scissors.

cards.power: Bore to Death. Narcissist loses interest and wanders off.
cards.lore: I am boring. I am uninteresting. Go away.

cards.power: Boundaries. Cancel a Gaslighting effect.
cards.lore: No. (A complete sentence).

cards.power: No Contact. Leave the game. You win by not playing.
cards.lore: The only winning move.
